title: Output from the initial false state
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$, the one-pass transducer whose state is a bit, whose transition sends $(q,b)$ to $q \wedge b$, and which emits a true bit exactly when $q \wedge b$ is true produces the empty word on input $w$ when started in the false state.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean word
